Phone-inspired image prompts for casual capture, HDR, portrait mode, flash and imperfect footage.

**Base prompt**

```text wrap
Two people talking, leaning on their car, with a suburban house in the background, dog playing in the yard.
```

## iPhone Everyday

![Balanced daylight exposure and a casual moderately wide view: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/iphone-everyday.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as an everyday rear-camera iPhone snapshot. Use a moderately wide view, mostly deep focus, balanced computational exposure, natural skin tones and clean, slightly sharpened detail. Preserve visible texture in bright areas and shadows. Keep the composition casual and spontaneous, with ordinary daylight and no dramatic cinematic color grade.
```

A clean, casual contemporary phone baseline.

## Android Vivid HDR

![Vivid blues and greens, lifted shadows and crisp detail: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/android-vivid-hdr.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as a vivid computational Android phone snapshot. Use a wide main-camera view, deep focus, lifted shadow detail, protected bright areas, punchy blues and greens and crisp local contrast. Keep faces plausible while making the overall colors lively. The framing should feel casually handheld rather than arranged like a cinema shot.
```

Vivid computational HDR with lifted shadows and punchy colors.

## Portrait Mode

![Sharp people against a softly blurred recognizable background: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/portrait-mode.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as a phone portrait-mode snapshot. Keep the two people sharply focused, with soft computational background blur and a gentle falloff in detail behind them. Use natural daylight, pleasing skin tones and a casually handheld composition. The blur should feel like a phone depth effect rather than dramatic cinema optics, with the setting still recognizable.
```

Personal conversations and attention on the people.

## Ultrawide

![A broad view, deep focus and stretched edge perspective: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/ultrawide.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as a phone ultrawide-camera snapshot. Use a very broad field of view, deep focus, exaggerated near-to-far distances and noticeable perspective stretching near the edges. Keep ordinary automatic daylight exposure and a casual handheld composition. Let the setting occupy more of the image than in a standard phone photograph.
```

Energetic spatial views and an expansive casual scene.

## Night Mode

![Brightened dusk shadows, available lights and slightly smoothed detail: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/night-mode.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as a computational phone night-mode image after dusk. Use brightened shadows, restrained noise, visible sky color and small pools of available light. Keep fine detail slightly smoothed by multi-frame processing, with subtle motion softness in moving subjects. The image should feel surprisingly bright for nighttime without becoming studio-lit or heavily cinematic.
```

Nighttime observation with the characteristic brightened phone treatment.

## Direct Flash

![Flat frontal flash and a darker background: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/direct-flash.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as a casual phone snapshot taken with a small direct flash at night. Use bright flat frontal light on nearby subjects, hard shadows behind them, shiny highlights and rapid falloff into a darker background. Keep the framing spontaneous and the colors straightforward. Create an immediate, slightly awkward party-snapshot feeling.
```

Awkward comedy, candid encounters and abrupt found footage.

## Casual Video Frame

![Casual framing, mild motion softness and video compression: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/casual-video-frame.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Render this as a single frame from a casual handheld phone video. Use automatic exposure, everyday color, deep focus, mild motion softness, subtle compression and imperfect spontaneous framing. Keep the image recognizable and readable, but less polished than a posed photo. Convey the sense that someone nearby simply started recording.
```

Social clips, observational dialogue and found phone footage.

## Golden-hour Phone

![Warm backlight, mild flare and brightened face shadows: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/golden-hour-phone.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as a casually captured phone image in warm golden-hour light. Use automatic exposure, warm backlight, a little lens flare, gently brightened face shadows and the deep focus of a small camera. Keep the image informal and lightly sharpened, with fresh colors and a pleasant everyday mood rather than a carefully lit cinema treatment.
```

Warm memories and relaxed phone diaries.

## Early Camera Phone

![Low detail, compression, clipped highlights and small-sensor noise: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/early-camera-phone.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as an early camera-phone image. Use limited fine detail, small-sensor noise, coarse JPEG compression, clipped bright areas, weak shadow detail and slightly inaccurate automatic white balance. Keep a casual snapshot composition and recognizable subjects. Make the imperfections feel like inexpensive capture, without adding a phone screen, interface or timestamp.
```

Older digital memories and rough evidence footage.

## Monochrome Phone

![Clean digital grayscale, deep focus and casual framing: two people talking beside their car, a suburban house behind them and a dog in the yard.](https://plugin-assets.filmopen.ai/fo-styles/v1/cell-phone/monochrome-phone.jpg)

**Prompt**

```text wrap
Photograph this as an everyday phone snapshot with a monochrome camera filter. Use crisp digital black and white, deep focus, automatic balanced exposure and modest local sharpening. Keep ordinary daylight and casual framing, with a clean grayscale rendering and no photochemical grain. The mood is immediate and observational rather than classic film noir.
```

Simple monochrome phone footage with a digital finish.
